1| package ingest
2| 
3| import (
4| 	"sync"
5| 	"time"
6| )
7| 
8| // tenantLimiter is a per-tenant token bucket. Buckets are created
9| // lazily on first sight of a tenant and refilled on a fixed tick; the
10| // per-tenant rates come from the tenants file and hot-reload with it.
11| type tenantLimiter struct {
12| 	mu      sync.Mutex
13| 	buckets map[string]*bucket
14| 	tick    time.Duration
15| }
16| 
17| type bucket struct {
18| 	tokens float64
19| 	rate   float64
20| 	burst  float64
21| 	last   time.Time
22| }
23| 
24| // allow reports whether one accepted batch fits the tenant's current
25| // budget. Unknown tenants get the default rate until the tenants file
26| // names them explicitly; the default is deliberately conservative so a
27| // new integration cannot crowd out established ones.
28| func (l *tenantLimiter) allow(tenant string, now time.Time) bool {
29| 	l.mu.Lock()
30| 	defer l.mu.Unlock()
31| 	b, ok := l.buckets[tenant]
32| 	if !ok {
33| 		b = l.newBucket(tenant)
34| 		l.buckets[tenant] = b
35| 	}
36| 	b.refill(now)
37| 	if b.tokens < 1 {
38| 		return false
39| 	}
40| 	b.tokens--
41| 	return true
42| }
43| 
44| func (b *bucket) refill(now time.Time) {
45| 	elapsed := now.Sub(b.last).Seconds()
46| 	b.tokens += elapsed * b.rate
47| 	if b.tokens > b.burst {
48| 		b.tokens = b.burst
49| 	}
50| 	b.last = now
51| }

1| # driftwatch operations
2| 
3| driftwatch ships as a single static binary. Run it under a process
4| supervisor with the spool on local disk, and point producers at a
5| stable DNS name rather than an address.
6| 
7| ## Restarts
8| 
9| Send SIGTERM and wait. Ingest stops accepting, the spool drains for a
10| bounded grace period, and anything still buffered is picked up on the
11| next start. No manual intervention is required.
12| 
13| ## Credential rotation
14| 
15| Rotations are staged through config: add the incoming credential shape
16| to the accepted set, migrate producers, then narrow the accepted set
17| again once the drain completes. Never narrow first; producers signing
18| with retired credentials are rejected at the edge.
19| 
20| ## Tenants
21| 
22| Per-tenant ingest budgets live in the tenants file and hot-reload on
23| change. Prefer explicit entries for every production tenant; the
24| built-in default exists for evaluation, not for steady state.
